One of the biggest problems is cross contamination due to insanely high sensitivity. Basically if you cut something like bread with a knife and use that same knife to cut me an apple without cleaning it first(fully washing it with soap), that small amount of gluten will be enough for me to get sick.

Then there are the additives in foods and just food made on the same equipment as other foods with gluten.

Also, gluten is a mix of proteins made of different versions of the gultenin and gliadin families of proteins. It occurs naturally primarily in wheat, barley and rye along with other grains like spelt. It's a binder and also the reason why dough made from wheat is so elastic and can be shaped so well and why the finished foods will be able to hold such a light texture without collapsing.
